shots.text: When his army was spent, he came out himself.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The fortress gates opening. Vael-Orrun walking out: huge, bare, dark hard-muscled hide, the molten core burning behind his ribs.

shots.text: Six of you. Always six. Ask them what they did at my table.
shots.speaker: vael_orrun
shots.art_note: Vael-Orrun turning toward the six Wardens.

shots.text: None of the Wardens answered him.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The six Wardens, silent. Thalassa is the only one who meets his eyes.
